body: Hi {player_name}, are you at your desk right now? I need a quick favour in the next few minutes, it really can't wait.[[t3]][[t5]]

tells.flag: 'OpsDesk_Live' is not a person or team in the staff directory
Won't say what the favour is until you commit
tells.text: I'll explain once you confirm you're free.
Please don't mention this to your manager.

explanation: Urgency is used to stop you thinking. An unverifiable sender who hides the actual ask is a classic opener that tests whether you will engage.

subject: Invoice hold - action needed today
body:
Hello {player_name},
A supplier invoice (ref INV-48812) assigned to your cost centre is about to lapse. I need you to confirm you are the approver so I can release it.[[t3]][[t5]]

tells.flag: Sender domain 'northstar-pay.example' is not the company domain 'northstar.example'
Pressure to bypass the normal approval queue
tells.text: It lapses at 5 pm today, so there is no time to route it through the usual approval queue.

tells.flag: Asks for a code by reply
tells.text: Reply with your approval code right away.

explanation: A believable business story plus a deadline pushes you to skip the process that would expose it. The off-domain sender is the giveaway.

body: Northstar IT: your VPN token expires in 15 minutes. Re-enter your login at northstar-vpn-renew.example/s to keep access.[[t4]][[t5]]

tells.flag: The link domain is not the company's, and IT does not collect logins via text links
Threat of lockout to rush you
tells.text: Act now or you will be locked out for 3 days.

tells.flag: Tells you not to use the official helpdesk
tells.text: Do NOT contact the helpdesk, they are overloaded.

explanation: The request (enter your login) is hidden behind a countdown. Real credential renewals never ask you to type a password into a link from a text.

subject: Call transcript
body: Caller: 'This is Dennis from the payments team, calling again. The wire goes out in ten minutes and I still need your sign-off.[[t3]][[t5]]'

tells.flag: Nobody named Dennis appears on the payments team roster, and you never signed off on this wire
Discourages you from calling back on a known number
tells.text: If you hang up and call back we will miss the window.
Just read me your authoriser PIN and we are done.

explanation: After earlier contact, the pressure is turned up. Stopping you from independently calling back is the scammer's most important move.
